title: レバーを上げた手動シトラスプレス
description: カフェやジュース店の台上に置く手動柑橘プレス。重い台座と柱、固定された高いレバーとリンク、内側が開いた押し鐘、リブ付き円錐リーマー、深さのある受け皿と吐出口外形を造形しています。果物や受けグラスは含まず、台の高さに合わせて配置します。レバー・搾汁・液体経路は動作せず、食品接触や圧搾性能を検証した実用品設計ではない静的小物です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.238 × 0.689 × 0.426 m、8,220三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A manual citrus press for cafe and juice-counter scenes. A weighted base and column support the raised fixed lever/link, hollow pressing bell, ribbed conical reamer, recessed collecting bowl and outlet exterior. Fruit and a receiving glass are omitted; place at counter height. Lever movement, juicing and liquid flow are not implemented. This static prop is not a validated food-contact or pressing-equipment design. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.238 × 0.689 × 0.426 m; 8,220 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
